The Vevor 38in Stainless Steel Dog Washing Station is an absolute game-changer! I wasn’t sure if our 40 lb heeler would fit, but she fits perfectly—and it also works great for our smaller poodles. The station was fairly easy to assemble; however, we did need to use different hoses since our home’s water valve connections weren’t compatible with the ones provided. Other than that, we had zero issues with assembly, no leaks during bath time, and found it to be extremely convenient. Highly recommend!
